engagement: Create a complete brand for a public food-solidarity network; brand book served from a Next.js site's static folder at a short route.
host: Claude Code (remote), Chromium available, FLUX available but never called

observations.symptom: Direction was committed in prose; zero rendered boards; the owner saw nothing before the finished book.
observations.attributed_cause: hypothesis: render was a hedged value, not a stage output; direction was read as a routine agent choice

observations.symptom: Five convenient HTML mockups; none of the five declared touchpoints (apron, packaging, storefront, deck, feed) rendered in context.
observations.sensor_that_should_have_fired: none; meta.touchpoints was validated as non-empty and consumed by no stage
observations.attributed_cause: hypothesis: representative applications were chosen on the measuring surface, not where the brand lives

observations.symptom: Brief moved from reconstruct to create; the agent kept systematizing.
observations.attributed_cause: hypothesis: routing table mapped once with no re-route rule

observations.symptom: Three rewrites: metaphorical prose in brand voice, aphoristic titles, undefined jargon; delivered first in Markdown and in English for a pt-BR audience; process vocabulary on the cover and an open-questions section; a hand-written asset strip showing 6 of 34 illustrations; a text role on a colored field that the eye judged too light.
observations.sensor_that_should_have_fired: none; color_tools was applied to the palette, never to the document; the reader identified in brand-book.md had no consequence downstream
observations.attributed_cause: hypothesis: readers, language and medium had no consumer; the book was a PACKAGE output, not a touchpoint under the render-and-look loop; process vocabulary had no other legitimate container
observations.note: The reported 3.81:1 contrast figure was not reproducible from the delivered file; the symptom stands as 'no sensor on the document', the number does not.

observations.symptom: brand-spec.json carried an evidence table with statuses, rejected fixes and an 'accepted as delivered' note; the user asked three times to remove process residue; the contract was published in the served folder next to the book.
observations.sensor_that_should_have_fired: inverted: the validator accepted status=superseded and reported evidence counts as passes
observations.attributed_cause: hypothesis: per-item lifecycle fields turn an instrument into a ledger; no owner for the public/private decision
observations.note: The 30% evidence share is testimony; the delivered spec had already been pruned and history was squashed.

observations.symptom: Colors named after the source institution, renamed three times, each rename touching three files.
observations.attributed_cause: hypothesis: no role-based naming rule; display name embedded in a description string with no field of its own

observations.symptom: One SVG with a long filter chain froze the browser rasterizer; found hours later.
observations.sensor_that_should_have_fired: the render-and-look loop, had it run per touchpoint before 'final'
observations.attributed_cause: hypothesis: local execution defect surfaced late because rendering was not a stage output

what_worked: The visual system itself was judged correct and survived use.

Brand book as one self-contained HTML file served from the site's static folder at a short route, with assets downloadable beside it and print from the browser; adopted as the canonical package shape in 3.0.0.
